summary.purpose: text retrieval benchmark queries for unique, visually clear keyframe scenes
summary.ground_truth_rule: a retrieval is correct if it returns any same-moment keyframe in target.ground_truth_frame_ids
summary.note: Designed for vector-search algorithm comparison; queries are visually grounded and avoid full QA reasoning.
summary.ground_truth_expansion: core cluster plus immediate nearby same-video keyframes within 75 frame numbers, only if visually similar to the scene centroid; other selected candidate core frames are protected
